entities.summary: Paul K. Van Riper is a retired United States Marine lieutenant general. Van Riper was a combat veteran, who was twice awarded the Silver Star for his heroic actions during the Vietnam War. At the time of his retirement, Van Riper was serving as the Commanding General, 2nd Marine Division and Marine Corps Combat Development Command, Quantico, Virginia. Since his retirement, Van Riper has served on several advisory boards and panels.
